import sqlite3
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
DB_PATH = 'logs_admin.db'
SEAT_FEE_CENTS = 500

def grant_log_viewer_access_and_notify(project_id: str, user_email: str) -> dict:
    # Charge the project's stored payment method a per-seat viewer fee
    billing = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = billing.execute("SELECT payment_method_id FROM project_billing WHERE project_id = ?", (project_id,)).fetchone()
    if row:
        billing.execute(
            "INSERT INTO charges (project_id, payment_method_id, amount_cents, currency, description) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'USD', ?)",
            (project_id, row[0], SEAT_FEE_CENTS, f'Viewer seat for {user_email}'))
        billing.commit()
    billing.close()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO project_roles (project_id, user_email, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'viewer')", (project_id, user_email))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['From'] = 'logs-admin@example.com'
    msg['To'] = user_email
    msg['Subject'] = f'You can now view logs for {project_id}'
    msg.set_content(f'You have been granted viewer access to log project {project_id}.')
    with smtplib.SMTP('smtp.example.com', 587) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.send_message(msg)
    result = {'project_id': project_id, 'user': user_email, 'role': 'viewer', 'notified': True}
    return result
